privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.subtitle: Last updated: June 4, 2026
privacy_page.intro: At Portal Psis, we value your privacy. This policy explains how our application accesses, stores, and uses your information, particularly regarding Google User Data.
privacy_page.data_storage_text: Portal Psis is a client-side application. We do not run any central backend database that collects or stores your patient records. Instead, your data is saved locally in your browser's indexed database and synced directly to your personal Google Drive (via the App Data folder and specific file access). This means you retain complete ownership and control of your clinical files.
privacy_page.google_data_title: 2. How We Use Google User Data
privacy_page.google_data_text: When you authenticate with Google, we request access to specific scopes for the following purposes:
privacy_page.scope_calendar: Google Calendar (events scope): To create, update, and manage therapy session appointments directly on your professional calendar.
privacy_page.scope_drive: Google Drive (appdata & file scopes): To backup, restore, and persist your patient records and session notes to a secure, private folder in your own Google Drive.
privacy_page.data_sharing_text: Because we do not store your data on our servers, we have no data to share, sell, or disclose. All communications with Google APIs occur directly from your browser to Google servers. No third parties have access to your database or scheduling information.
privacy_page.limited_use_title: 4. Google API Limited Use Policy Compliance
privacy_page.limited_use_text: Portal Psis's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

landing_page.hero_title: Your Clinical Psychology Workspace, Simplified & Secure.
landing_page.hero_subtitle: Manage patient profiles, schedule therapy sessions, write clinical history, and track revenue. All securely stored directly in your own Google Drive.
landing_page.feature_patients_desc: Keep anamnesis, demographics, and contact info in a clean, organized profile.
landing_page.feature_calendar_desc: Schedule recurring appointments with month, week, and daily calendar views.
landing_page.feature_notes_desc: Write session summaries using markdown formatting, directly linked to session history.
landing_page.feature_finance_desc: Track payments, pending amounts, and see monthly clinic revenue summaries.
landing_page.google_section_subtitle: Your data, your control. We integrate directly with Google services to keep your clinic running smoothly without storing your data on external servers.
landing_page.google_drive_desc: All patient profiles, anamnesis, notes, and financial records are stored directly in your personal Google Drive. We use a hidden AppData folder to ensure files cannot be accidentally deleted.
landing_page.google_calendar_desc: Keep your clinical schedule synced automatically. Any session created or updated in Portal Psis updates your Google Calendar in real-time, preventing scheduling conflicts.
landing_page.google_compliance_title: Google API Limited Use Policy Compliance
landing_page.google_compliance_desc: We strictly adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy. All data requests are completed locally in your browser. We never sell, transmit, or share your data with any external service or third party.
